target: 741 “Aestimatio”

source: 741 “Appraisal”
target: 741 “Aestimatio”

source: “What else does it do?”
target: «Quid aliud facit?»

source: Lumian, seeing Ludwig pause as if he had concerns, pressed for an answer.
target: Lumian, Ludwicum morari quasi sollicito animo videns, instavit ut responsum daret.

source: Ludwig stared at the piece of umbilical cord in front of Lumian and hesitated before replying, “It could somewhat alter your aura and lineage, making certain creatures without the necessary wisdom perceive you as a divine child of the ‘Great Mother.”
target: Ludwig in particulam funiculi umbilicalis coram Lumiano aspexit et haesitavit antequam respondit: «Hoc aliquatenus tuam auram atque stirpem mutare potest, ita ut quaedam ingenia, carentia sapientia necessaria, te ut divinam prolem Magnae Matris percipiant.»

source: Lumian’s expression grew more solemn.
target: Vultus Lumiani gravior factus est.

source: “So, you’re saying it could actually integrate the Child of God’s lineage into mine, even if it’s almost negligible?”
target: «Ita ergo dicis posse vere stirpem Filii Dei in meam inserere, etiamsi ea fere exiguum videantur?»

source: And this would fool creatures of low intelligence or those acting purely on instinct?
target: Et hoc falleret creaturas parvae intelligentiae vel quae tantum instinctu agunt?

source: “Yes.” Ludwig nodded earnestly. “That bit of lineage won’t change anything for you, and only creatures directly created by the ‘Great Mother’ or those who have received Her boons could sense it.”
target: «Ita.» Ludwig sincere annuit. «Ea stirps nihil tibi mutabit; solum enim creaturae, quae directe a Magnae Matris creatae sunt aut quae beneficia Eius acceperunt, id percipere possunt.»

source: This doesn’t sound very useful, but in special circumstances, it could be incredibly crucial.
target: Hoc non valde utile videtur, sed in certis casibus incredibiliter momenti esse potest.

source: Compared to curing infertility or enhancing self-healing, it has more room for imagination…
target: Comparatum ad infertilitatis curandam aut ad auto-sanationem augendam, amplius locus imaginationi adest…

source: Lumian weighed his words and asked, “What are the side effects?”
target: Lumian verba sua deliberavit atque rogavit: «Quae sunt effectus laterales?»

source: Could it change my gender? After all, the Great Mother’s’ Child of God, Omebella, seems to have been female.
target: Poteritne genus meum mutare? Denique, proles Dei Magnae Matris, Omebella, videtur fuisse femina.

source: Ludwig’s greedy gaze shifted from the umbilical cord back to Lumian, and he said regretfully, “For someone else, it might cause the ‘Great Mother’s’ Child of God to start developing inside them, but not for you. You just have to worry about the ‘Great Mother’ setting Her sights on you, really watching you.”
target: Ludwig, aspectu avaro a funiculo umbilicali ad Lumianum reverto, paenitenter dixit: «Alio forsitan hoc efficiet ut proles Dei Magnae Matris in eo evolvatur, sed tibi non; solum cavendum est ne Magna Mater in te intendat, te vere observans.»

source: Lumian was silent for a good twenty seconds before slowly stowing Omebella’s umbilical cord remains back into his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian viginti secundos silentium tenuit, deinde lente reliquias funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae in sacculum Viatoris recondidit.

source: He wasn’t in a hurry to have Ludwig use the remains to create food with special effects, planning instead to consult Madam Magician’s opinion before deciding.
target: Non festinavit ut Ludwig reliquias ad cibum cum effectibus specialibus creandum adhibeat; potius consilium Dominae Magicarum quaerere constitui priusquam decerneret.

source: He was willing to take risks, but he wasn’t reckless.
target: Paratus erat pericula subire, sed non temerarius fuit.

source: “Can I have it now?” Ludwig looked eagerly at the matte Deprivation Bullet.
target: «Num nunc illam habeam?» Ludwig avidē ad pilam opacam “Deprivationis” respexit.

source: “One last question.” Lumian smiled again, pulling out another item from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: «Una ultima quaestio.» Lumian iterum subridet, extrahens alterum rem ex sacculo Viatoris.

source: It was a small glass vial containing ancient bloodstain powder.
target: Erat parva ampulla vitrea, quae pulverem antiqui sanguinis maculae continebat.

source: This came from Demon Warlock Burman, who was guided by a visitor from Resurrection Island named Harrison.
target: Hoc provenit a Daemone Magico Burman, qui a viatore ex Insula Resurrectionis, nomine Harrison, ductus erat.

source: He summoned a spirit named Arden from the depths of death and easily killed it, collecting its blood for a future ritual.
target: Spiritum nomine Arden e profundis mortis evocavit et facile occidit, eiusque sanguinem ad futurum ritum colligens.

source: Lumian got some of this bloodstain powder from his room.
target: Lumian ex camera sua aliquod ex hoc pulvere antiqui sanguinis maculae obtinuit.

source: Previously, Lumian had Franca conduct an investigation using Magic Mirror Divination, confirming that it truly came from the depths of the spirit world but yielded no further insights. Now, he wanted the Gourmet to taste it, to see if he could glean more important information.
target: Antehac, Lumian Francam per Divinationem Speculi Magici inquisitionem gerere curavit, confirmans id vere ex profundis mundi spirituum provenire, sed nullas ulteriores notitias praestitisse; nunc autem volebat ut Gourmet id gustaret, ut videat an notitias magni momenti exhaurire possit.

source: He remembered clearly; the people of Resurrection Island claimed they could die and revive repeatedly, never aging, and the secret was in their control over the markings from the depths of death.
target: Clare meminit; populi Insulae Resurrectionis dicebant se posse mori et reviviscere saepius, numquam senescere, et secretum in sua potestate super signa e profundis mortis iacere.

source: This might truly be a way to revive the dead.
target: Forsitan vere via sit ad mortuos reviviscendos.

source: “Is it edible?” Lumian maintained his smile as he pushed the glass vial with the ancient bloodstain powder towards Ludwig.
target: «Num edule sit?» Lumian risum retinuit, dum ampullam vitream cum antiquo pulvere sanguinis maculae ad Ludwicum protraxit.

source: Ludwig carefully examined the powder for a while and then opened the bottle cap, touching it a few times with his fingers.
target: Ludwig pulverem aliquantisper diligenter examinavit deinde operculum ampullae aperuit, et paucis temporibus digitis in eam tetigit.

source: “Yes,” he replied, not too eagerly.
target: «Ita,» respondit, non nimis avidē.

source: “Then eat half of it.” Lumian watched expectantly as Ludwig sprinkled a small amount of the ancient bloodstain powder into his mouth, leaving just a bit behind.
target: «Tunc medietatem eius edas.» Lumian exspectans animadvertit, dum Ludwig parvam portionem pulveris antiqui sanguinis maculae in os suum aspergebat, reliquum parvum relinquens.

source: Ludwig chewed and tasted it for a while before starting his “gourmet review”: “It has a rich aroma of death and eternal rest, originating from the depths of the spirit world.
target: Ludwig aliquantisper masticavit et gustavit, deinde recensionem suam gourmandilicam inchoavit: «Habet divitem odorem mortis atque quietis aeternae, proveniens ex profundis mundi spirituum.»

source: “It comes from a man in his thirties, with traits of both the Mystery Pryer and Death pathways, in poor mental state, highly prone to emotional instability…”
target: «Ex viro in tricesima aetate orto est, qui notis et moribus tam viae Mysterii inquisitoris quam Mortis pollentem sit, mente debili et ad perturbationes affectuum valde inclinato…»

source: Hearing this, Lumian raised an eyebrow.
target: Hoc audito, Lumian supercilium attollit.

source: This sounds like it’s describing Demon Warlock Burman himself!
target: Hoc videtur ipsum Daemoni Magi Burman describere!

source: But this bloodstain powder is from the evil spirit Arden killed by Burman, right?
target: Sed hic pulver sanguinis maculae ex malo spiritu provenit, quem Arden a Burman occidit, nonne?

source: “From Intis’s Winter Province?” Lumian confirmed his guess.
target: «Ex Provincia Hiemali Intis?» Lumian coniecturam suam confirmavit.

source: “Yes.” Ludwig smacked his lips.
target: «Ita.» Ludwig labia crepuit.

source: He shared other insights drawn from the bloodstain powder, each aligning with the Demon Warlock’s situation.
target: Alias indagationes ex hoc pulvere extractas communicavit, singulas cum casu Daemoni Magi congruentes.

source: This couldn’t possibly mean that Burman summoned himself, killed himself, and then collected his own blood, could it?
target: Hoc nequaquam potest significare quod Burman se ipse evocaverit, se interemit, ac suum sanguinem collexerit, nonne?

source: Lumian felt an eerie thrill.
target: Lumian excitationem insolitam sensit.

source: The ancient bloodstain powder surely wasn’t left by Burman due to some other issues, as both Franca and Ludwig had confirmed the blood was closely linked to death and the spirit world. Lumian had fought the Demon Warlock twice, believing him to still be alive at those times.
target: Antiquus pulver sanguinis maculae certe non a Burman relicuus fuit, quoniam et Franca et Ludwig confirmaverunt sanguinem arcte ad mortem et mundum spirituum pertinere; Lumian bis cum Daemone Mago pugnaverat, eum tempore adhuc vivum esse crederet.

source: Using the method taught by Resurrection Island’s Harrison, Burman summoned an evil spirit from the depths of death that was himself, er, his own marking?
target: Usu methodi a Harrison Insulae Resurrectionis tradita, Burman spiritum malum e profundis mortis evocavit, qui erat ipse—heu—suum proprium signum?

source: He killed his own marking in the depths of death and found it very weak?
target: Ipse signum suum in profundis mortis occidit et constitui id valde debile esse?

source: This is hard to believe…
target: Hoc crederi difficile est…

source: What exactly does Harrison from Resurrection Island want, and what hidden truths lie behind the islanders’ resurrections?
target: Quid prorsus vult Harrison ex Insula Resurrectionis, et quae arcana veritates resurrectionum insularum tegunt?

source: Lumian’s thoughts raced, feeling that the mysteries of Resurrection Island were no less profound than the high-level events he had experienced before.
target: Cogitationes Lumiani cursabant, existimans mysteria Insulae Resurrectionis non esse minus profunda quam eventa summi gradus, quae antea experitur.

source: “Can you give it to me now?” Ludwig looked again at the Deprivation Bullet, very eagerly.
target: «Potesne nunc illam mihi dare?» Ludwig iterum ad pilam Deprivationis, valde avidus, aspiciens.

source: He handed back the small glass vial with the remaining bit of ancient bloodstain powder to Lumian.
target: Illam parvam ampullam vitream cum reliquo pulveris antiqui sanguinis maculae munere Lumiano reddidit.

source: “Yes.” Lumian tossed the Deprivation Bullet to Ludwig.
target: «Ita.» Lumian pilam Deprivationis ad Ludwicum iecit.

source: Ludwig caught it, and stuffed the matte bullet into his mouth.
target: Ludwig eam cepit et pilam opacam in os suum intulit.

source: “Eating it directly?” Lumian asked with a chuckle, “Aren’t you going to cook it first? Maybe mix a cocktail?”
target: «Illud directe edes?» Lumian subridebat: «Nonne prius coquere vel mixturam potionis parare vis?»

source: Ludwig replied with a muffled voice, “No need for that, I can absorb it directly.”
target: Ludwig voce submissa respondit: «Non opus est; illud directe absorbere possum.»

source: As he spoke, he sucked on the Deprivation Bullet like it was an ice pop, pulling it from his mouth again.
target: Dum loquebatur, pilam Deprivationis quasi sorbetum glacialem sugere coepit, eam ex ore iterum extrahens.

source: Compared to before, the bullet’s matte metal casing had noticeably thinned, the intricate symbols etched into its surface now pitted and marked with teeth impressions.
target: Comparata priore, involucro metallico opaco pilulae evidenter tenuatum erat, et insignia intricata in eius superficie nunc cavata et dentibus impressa erant.

source: Ludwig sucked on it three times, then finally, when the inside gunpowder was vaguely visible, he put the bullet in his mouth, chewed it with a crackling sound, and swallowed.
target: Ludwig eam ter sugivit, deinde denique, cum intus pulvis ignitus vage apparebat, pilam in os suum intulit, crepitans masticavit et deglutivit.

source: Lumian watched with a grimace, gaining a deeper understanding of the various changes hunger could bring.
target: Lumian facie contrita observabat, profundiorem intellegentiam variarum mutationum, quas fames adferre posset, adipisciens.

source: After eating the Deprivation Bullet, Ludwig closed his eyes, savoring the taste and longing for more.
target: Postquam pilam Deprivationis comedit, Ludwig oculos clausit, saporem degustans et amplius desiderans.

source: Lumian felt a pang of regret for the extraordinary bullet he had obtained from Jebus.
target: Lumian dolorem paenitentiae sensit propter illam pilam extraordinariam, quam a Jebus acquirerat.

source: The Weakening Bullet, Deprivation Bullet, and Implosion Bullet had not served their intended purposes, while the Poison Bullet, Putrid Bullet, and Impregnating Bullet had been given to Franca.
target: Pila debilitans, pila Deprivationis, et pila Implosionis munera proposita non perfuncta habuerunt, at pila venenata, pila putrida, et pila impregnante Francae traditae sunt.

source: “How do you feel?” Lumian inquired.
target: «Quomodo te sentis?» Lumian quaesivit.

source: “Delicious, a familiar taste,” Ludwig responded, half-closing his eyes.
target: «Deliciosum, gustus familiaris,» Ludwig respondit, dimidio oculis clausis.

source: After reflecting for a moment, he snapped his eyes open, their gaze sharp and alert.
target: Postquam paulisper meditatus est, subito oculos aperuit, quorum aspectus acutus et vigilantissimus erat.

source: “G-Godfather, can you quickly find out who made that bullet?”
target: «G-Godfather, potesne celeriter detegere qui illam pilam fecit?»

source: You little rascal, that’s the cult following your deity… But I can’t blame you, you’re brainless now.. And for an evil god, sacrificing any number of bestowed is worthwhile if it frees an angel from its bonds, returning to an Angel’s belly is like returning to the deity’s heaven…
target: «Parve pravule, hic est cultus sectarius deitatis tuae… Sed te non reprehendo, nam nunc sine mente es… Et pro deo malo, sacrificare quolibet numerum donorum pretium habet, si angelum a vinculis solverit; reditus in ventrem angeli similis est reditui in caelum deitatis…»

source: Lumian muttered silently to himself, nodded slightly in agreement, and slowly stood up, heading back to his bedroom.
target: Lumian tacite sibi murmuravit, leviter annuit consentiente, et lente surrexit, ad cameram suam tendens.

source: Lying in bed, he stared at the dark ceiling adorned with a chandelier, feeling no trace of sleepiness despite the lingering scent of absinthe.
target: Cubans in lecto, aspiciens ad obscurum laquearium ornatum candelabro, non sensit ullum vestigium somnolentiae, quamquam odor absinthii permansit.

source: After staring silently for who knows how long, Lumian chuckled self-deprecatingly, trying to use Cogitation to help himself fall asleep.
target: Postquam silentio diu aspexit, Lumian seipsum irridebat, conans Cogitationem ad somnum se inducendum uti.

source: He slowly visualized a crossed-out sphere that grew an eye in his mind.
target: Leniter imaginatus est sphaeram deletam, quae in animo eius oculum genuit.

source: His state settled, and drowsiness began to creep up.
target: Status eius se stabilivit, et somnolentia paulatim insidiari coepit.

source: Just then, Lumian was taken aback.
target: Modo, Lumian obstupefactus est.

source: Cogitation was taught by his sister, and the Cogitation pattern was also casually drawn by her…
target: Cogitatio a sorore eius tradita est, et eius exemplum quoque leviter ab ea delineatum fuit…

source: Lumian laughed softly to himself, his laughter shaking.
target: Lumian molliter se ipsi risit, risus eius trementes.

source: Minutes later, he indulged in reminiscing about his life in Cordu, including those interactions in the dream.
target: Minutis post, indulgebat recordatione vitae suae in Cordu, inter quas etiam illae interactiones in somniis memoratae erant.

source: Even those, now looking back, carried a certain indescribable warmth.
target: Etiam illa, nunc respicientes, aliquam caliditatem ineffabilem afferebant.

source: As his thoughts wandered, Lumian remembered his sister’s contracted creature, White Paper.
target: Dum cogitationes eius errabant, Lumian recordatus est creaturae contractae sororis suae, “Charta Alba.”

source: I wonder what state White Paper is in…
target: Miror in quo statu “Charta Alba” sit…

source: Strictly speaking, Aurore isn’t completely dead, so her contract with White Paper should still exist…
target: Stricte loquendo, Aurore non omnino mortua est, ideo pactum eius cum “Charta Alba” adhuc existere debet…

source: Pity, contract creatures aren’t messengers, only the contractee can summon them, otherwise, I’d summon White Paper to see its condition…
target: Eheu, creaturae contractae nuntii non sunt; solum contractus possessorem eas evocare potest, alioquin “Charta Alba” evocarem ut condicionem eius intuerer…

source: Using Aurore’s words, seeing something left behind makes you think of that person? Or, liking someone so much you even like their pets?
target: Ut verbis Aurore utendo, videns quod relictum est, te facit illum hominem reminiscere? Aut, aliquem tam diligis ut etiam eius amica animalia placeant?

source: Eh, it’s not that I can’t summon, since the Termiboros sealed inside me and I are one, Aurore’s soul shard must be too, my summoning is as if Aurore is doing it… Thinking this, Lumian abruptly sat up.
target: Heu, non est quod evocare non possim, cum Termiboros, qui in me clausus est, et ego unum simus, ita frustum animae Aurore debet esse; evocatio mea quasi ab Aurore fiat… Cogitans hoc, Lumian repente surrexit.

source: In the darkness, he set up an altar and chanted the spell in the appropriate language: “I!
target: In tenebris, altare posuit et incantationem in lingua apta recitavit: «Ego!»

source: “I summon in my name: “The spirit that wanders about the unfounded, a friendly creature that can be subordinated, the weak ball that can telepathically connect with me…”
target: «Ego in nomine meo evoceo: spiritum qui errat per incognitum, creaturam amicam quae subici possit, et pilam debilem quae mecum telepathice communicare valeat…»

source: As the incantation echoed, the candlelight flickered gently, but nothing happened.
target: Dum incantatio resonabat, lumen candelarum leniter micuit, sed nihil evenit.

source: With Spirit Vision active, Lumian didn’t see White Paper that had appeared in his dreams.
target: Cum Visio Spirituum activa esset, Lumian “Charta Alba” non vidit, quae in somniis eius apparuerat.

source: Sigh… He lay back down, disappointed.
target: Suspirans… Rursus se in lecto recubavit, destitus.

source: As time ticked by, the sleepless Lumian suddenly became alert, feeling not the slightest fatigue.
target: Dum tempus transibat, Lumian, insomnis, repente vigilantiam acceperat, nullam quidem lassitudinem sentiens.

source: It was six in the morning.
target: Era hora sexta mane.

source: Lumian got up silently and began to clean up the altar.
target: Lumian silentio surrexit et altare purgare inceperat.

source: Just then, a “doll” messenger in a light-gold dress emerged from the void, dropping a dark coin pouch and a folded square letter onto the table.
target: Modo, ex vacuum, nuntia “pupula” in veste aurea levi apparuit, deicens in mensa sacculum nummorum obscurum atque epistulam quadrangulam convolutam.

source: Is this the reward from Miss Magician? One of them is a Traveler’s Bag?
target: Num hoc praemium a Domina Magica est? Una inter ea num sacculus Viatoris sit?

source: Lumian perked up, grabbing the dark coin pouch.
target: Lumian subito excitatus, sacculum nummorum obscurum rapuit.

source: The “doll” messenger glanced at him, pinched her nose and said, “Drunkard! Your clothes stink!”
target: Nuntia “pupula” eum intuens, nasum suum comprimens, dixit: «Ebrio! Vestimenta tua foetida sunt!»

source: Uh… Lumian, who hadn’t bathed or changed clothes last night, cleared his throat awkwardly in embarrassment and thanked her.
target: Heu… Lumian, qui heri nocte neque se lavaverat neque vestimenta mutaverat, guttur difficultate purgans, erubescens, ei gratias egit.

source: After the “doll” messenger left, he continued to check the rewards.
target: Postquam nuntia “pupula” discessit, Lumian praemia perscrutari continuavit.
